Dukan Product

Isi Product ke andar neeche multiple Flavor + Weight + Rate add kar sakte hain.

🌈 Isi Product Mein Multi Flavor + Multi Weight

Ek hi Product Name ke neeche jitne Flavor/Weight chahen add karein. Har line ka Purchase Rate aur Sale Rate alag rahega. Misal: Chips → Masala 20g, BBQ 20g, Cheese 50g, Masala 100g.

🔎 Pehle Se Saved Product / Flavor Select Karein

Yahan aapki pehle se saved Dukan Products ki poori list hai. Product search/select karein, phir Flavor / Weight dropdown se koi bhi flavor choose karein. Select karte hi uska rate aa jayega. Yahin se Flavor ko Delete / Archive bhi kar sakte hain.
Pehle Product select karein.
Important: Agar Bari Unit / conversion maloom nahi, dono fields khaali chhor dein. Phir stock aur purchase sirf Choti Unit mein chalega. Baad mein conversion pata chale to Product Edit se add kar sakte hain.
Misal: 1 Carton = 12 Packet, Purchase Rs 2750 aur Sale Rs 2880.
Choti Unit ka rate system khud calculate karega.

Dukan Stock Purchase

Supplier select karein. Har purchase uske naam/number ke saath save hogi.
Ab payment (Jama) alag se nahi di jati — jab niche "Poora Bill Save Karein" dabayenge, tab hi wahan "Is Bill Mein Abhi Kitna Diya" likh kar ek sath bill + jama save hoti hai. Har Purchase Bill ka apna alag Baqaya aur Jama History rehta hai (Purchase Bill History mein dekhein).
Ab Purchase mein purani Product/Variant dropdown list nahi hai. Search karein, jis card ki quantity bharni ho usi card par likhein, phir ➕ Stock Mein Jama dabayein. Search badalne par pehle bhari hui quantity gum nahi hogi.
Maslan bill 49,723 tha, aap ne 49,500 diye to yahan 223 likhein. Ye discount har item ki cost se barabar kam ho jata hai, is liye bechte waqt munafa khud barh jata hai aur Buy Rate bhi kam ho kar average banta hai.
Bari aur Choti dono quantity ek saath bhi de sakte hain — misal: 2 Carton + 8 Packet.
Amount khali ho to Bari + Choti ke hisaab se automatic calculate hoga.
Agar Total Amount dein to system khud is purchase ka per-unit rate nikal kar Product ka Purchase Rate update kar dega, aur agar rate pehle se farak hua to alert aayega.
"Naya Sale Rate" dein to Sale Rate bhi isi purchase ke sath update ho jayega.

💰 Udhar / Jama — Farokht & Khareed

Farokht = jin ko aap ne Kabar bill di aur unse paisa lena hai. Khareed = jin se aap ne Kabar Stock Purchase kiya aur unhein paisa dena hai.

♻️ Qism-wise Riayat

Riayat Li mein purchase riayat ke saath bina-wazan maal ka extra nikla hua wazan (andaze se zyada/kam) bhi shamil hai. Wazan gain ki Bachat sale rate ke hisab se hai.
Qism Riayat Li
(Kg)		 Bachat
(Rs)		 Customer Ko Di
(Kg)		 Customer Ko Di
(Rs)
Koi riayat record nahi.

📊 Qism-wise Munafa

Munafa = Bikri − Cost − Customer Paisa Riayat − Extra Diya + Wazan Riayat Li + Bill Riayat Li − Extra Kharcha. Cost value sirf asal wazan × rate hai; Extra sirf profit se katta hai aur Invest mein judta hai.
Mukammal Report: har qism kholein to Abhi Stock, Kharidari, Kul Invest, Bikri aur Munafa ka poora hisaab milta hai.
Koi record nahi.

Kabar Qism

Rate hamesha 1 Kg ka dein. 500 Gram, 250 Gram waghera ka rate system khud calculate karega.

📅 Mahine Ka Hisaab — Roz Kitna

📦 Lot Khareed + Sorting (Fridge / TV jaisa maal)

Pehle naam chunein (list mein na ho to naya naam likhein), tafseel (jaise Fridge) aur total paise likhein, jama likhein — baqaya khud bante hai. Phir jo cheezein nikaleen (Loha, Pital, Silver, Copper, Kachra...) wo Kg + Gram ke saath likhein. OK dabane par bill ban jayega, nikla hua maal stock mein jama ho jayega aur munafa/nuqsan ki poori report ban jayegi.

♻️ Is maal se nikli hui cheezein

♻️ Mix Maal Se Alag Karein (Sorting)

Jab mix Kabar (jaise Loha) aata hai to poora wazan ek hi qism mein stock hota hai. Baad mein jab us mix se Pital, Copper, Silver, Plastic, Nylon ya koi bhi cheez nikal kar alag ki jaye, to yahan se wo wazan is (source) qism ke stock se minus hoga aur nikali gayi cheez apni qism ke stock mein khud-bakhud jama ho jayegi — taake baad mein asal (Loha) qism sell karte waqt stock sahi/kam dikhe.

📊 Sorting Report — Munafa / Nuqsan

Sorting se kis qism se kitna wazan gaya, kis mein aaya, cost value kitni idhar se udhar gayi, aur Sale Rate ke hisaab se andaza munafa/nuqsan. Ye andaza hai; asal munafa/nuqsan bill mein bechne par banta hai.

Kabar Dene Wala (Naam) Add Karein

Jis banday se aap kabar (loha, gata, plastic waghera) khareedte hain, uska naam yahan add karein. Phir har purchase us naam se save hogi. Naam add karna zaroori nahi — chahain to seedha "Counter" se bhi khareed sakte hain.

📦 Kabar Complete Purchase Bill — Maal Stock Mein Jama

Ek hi bande se Plastic, Gatta, Loha ya jitni bhi Kabar aaye, sab ko isi ek purchase bill mein line-by-line add karein. Bill save hote hi har item ka stock jama hoga.

⚡ Fast Add — Product Cards

Bilkul Dukan Product Bill jaisa: pehle ek qism search karke uske card mein fields bharein, phir doosri qism search karein aur uski apni fields bharein. Sab cards ki entries alag-alag save rahengi. Aakhir mein neeche ➕ Sab Selected Products Ek Sath Bill Mein Add Karein dabayein — tamam selected qismein ek hi purchase bill mein line-by-line chali jayengi.
Pehle item add karein → phir doosra item add karein → sab items current bill mein jama hote jayenge. Aakhir mein POORA PURCHASE BILL SAVE dabayein. Stock mein asal wazan jama hoga, lekin paison ka hisab asal wazan − Wazan Riayat par hoga. Yani Riayat paison ke bill se cut hogi, stock se nahi.
Bill Paisa Hisab: Neeche isi current bill ke andar Total ke baad Bill Riayat, Jama aur Extra Rakam bharein. Har value isi bill ke total ke saath adjust hokar save hogi. Misal: Total 2000 − Riayat 100 = Net Bill 1900; Jama 1500 ho to Baqaya 400 rahega. Agli baar isi supplier ka naya bill alag hisab se chalega.
Rate wala system bhi active hai: agar Purchase Rate / Special Rate ya Total Amount se naya rate purane Buy Rate se different hua to system Rate Farq History mein record karega aur farq + munafa par asar bhi batayega. Total Amount dene par per-Kg rate khud niklega.

⚖️ Kabar Total Wazan Check

Qism ka asal tola hua total wazan likhein. Agar system stock ke barabar ho to "Stock Mukammal Hai", zyada ho to "Mubarak", kam ho to "Maal Kam Hai" ka alert aata hai (Robo bhi bolta hai).

⚡ Kabar Cash Purchase — Baghair Wazan

Bachay ya koi banda kachra de aur aap sirf Rs. 10, 20, 50 waghera dein to yahan entry karein. Di hui rakam Actual Purchase Cost mein zaroor jayegi, aur usi waqt us qism ke Buy Rate ke hisab se andaza KG (paisa ÷ buy rate) stock mein jama ho jayega, cost value bhi barhegi. Baad mein sale par agar wazan andaze se zyada nikla to wo extra KG poora profit banega.

🧾 Kabar Complete Bill

Ek bill mein Loha 1 Kg 500 Gram, Plastic 2 Kg 250 Gram, Gata waghera sab aik saath add karein. Rate sirf 1 Kg ka dena hoga. System Gram ko automatically Kg mein convert karega. Stock kam ya zyada hone ki wajah se Kabar bill kabhi block nahi hoga.

⚡ Fast Add — Kai Qism Ek Sath Bill Mein

Tareeqa: Jin qismon ki quantity chahiye, un sab cards mein Kg/Gram likhein (checkbox khud tick ho jayega), phir neeche wala button dabayein — sab ek hi baar mein Kabar Bill mein add ho jayengi. Ek qism ke liye us card ka apna ➕ Bill Mein Add bhi use kar sakte hain.

💰 Bill Ka Final Hisaab — Riayat / Extra / Jama

Pehle items add karein. Har item mein Asal Wazan aur agar customer wazan kam gin raha ho to Wazan Riayat Kg/Gram likhein. Wazan Riayat ke baad jo Hisabi/Chargeable Wazan bachega usi par sale amount banega, lekin stock se asal poora wazan niklega. Neeche wali Paisa Riayat customer ki cash discount hai. Sale ki total Riayat pehle Purchase Riayat Balance se adjust hogi; jo us se zyada ho woh Confirmed Profit se kategi.

🔄 Kabar Maal Udhar — Saman Le Jana / Wapasi

Jab koi banda kaam ki koi cheez (qism) uthata/le jata hai aur turant paisa ya saman nahi deta — yahan record karein. Uska wazan turant stock se minus ho jayega. Jab wo baad mein paisa ya saman de, neeche list mein "Paisa Se Wapasi" ya "Saman Se Wapasi" button se hisaab settle karein. Jab tak settle na ho, list mein "Baqi" dikhta rahega — bhoolne ka khatra nahi.

Permanent Delete: is option se sirf is tab ka record delete hoga. Ye action undo nahi hoga.

🏠↔🏪 Ghar / Dukan Stock

Dekhein ke maal Ghar par kitna hai aur Dukan par kitna. Transfer se sirf jagah badalti hai, paisa ya munafa nahi badalta. Abhi ka sara stock Dukan par ginta hai; Ghar ka maal Dukan → Ghar transfer se likhein.

🛒 PRODUCT CARDS — Seedha Transfer Karein

Har product ka alag card hai. Bari / Choti (ya Kg / Gram) likhein, card khud tick ho jata hai. Ek ka 🔁 Transfer dabayein, ya kai cards mein quantity likh kar Sab Selected dabayein. Search badalne se likhi hui quantity nahi mitati.

✏️ STOCK THEEK KAREIN — Ghar / Dukan

Agar stock ghalat chadha hai to yahan se Ghar aur Dukan ki asal quantity likh kar 💾 Stock Theek Karein dabayein. Choti quantity upar hai. Kul stock = Ghar + Dukan. Har tabdeeli ka record Stock Adjustment history mein save hota hai. Upar “Kis ka stock” se Dukan ya Kabar chunein.

🏪 Supplier / Dukan Dar Compare Password

Mukhtalif dukandaron ke rate compare karein. Transport, loading, delivery ya koi bhi extra kharcha add karke asli (landed) rate niklega.

Rate Compare — kaun mujhe sasta/mehnga deta hai, aur main kis ko sasta/mehnga deta hoon

🔎 Kis Dukan Se Sasta Aur Behtar Maal?

Har supplier ka maal ka rate + tamam extra kharcha add karein. System effective/landed rate nikalega aur purane rate se saving ya mehngai batayega.
Important: Is comparison ko save karne se stock mein koi plus/minus nahi hota. Jab asal maal aaye tab Dukan Purchase/Stock mein entry karein.

⚡ Cost Rate + Rate Check

Neeche products dropdown mein band rahenge. Search se jis product ko dhoondhein, sirf wahi saamne rahega. Kisi product ko kholenge to usi ka Actual Rate aur Rate Check Karein khulega. Sab Products Kholein se poori list bhi khol sakte hain.

🏆 Supplier Ranking

Same product ke saved offers ko landed rate ke hisaab se compare kiya jayega. Quality/reliability bhi dikhai jayegi, taake sirf sasta nahi balki behtar supplier bhi samajh aaye.

🔑 Password Change Karein

Naya password set karne ke liye pehle purana password dein, phir naya password do baar likhein. Ye password Dukan, Order Book, Low/Khatam Stock, Rate & Bill aur Supplier Compare sab ka shared hai.
